name: Crystal receiver
description: A crystal that charges when a spell of charge or a beam of light reaches it, and stays charged (latching) until a signal resets it. The usual far-away target of an arrow-and-spell puzzle.

mode.description: latching stays charged until reset; momentary fades.

inputs.name: charge
inputs.description: A charge spell or light reaching it.

outputs.name: charged
outputs.description: On once the crystal has been charged.
